# zkmcu reference source subset

Source: https://github.com/Niek-Kamer/zkmcu
Pinned commit: `69b59e6b999ed69c5663878486f425cf8ed8fd14`.

This directory contains selected upstream reference files used to derive and
explain this application's membership proof. It is not a standalone Cargo
workspace and is not built as a dependency.

Retained upstream files:

- `crates/zkmcu-verifier-plonky3/src/pq_semaphore.rs`: original membership AIR.
- `crates/zkmcu-host-gen/src/pq_semaphore.rs`: original host proof reference.
- `research/notebook/2026-04-29-pq-semaphore-air-design.md`: original design notes.
- `LICENSE-MIT` and `LICENSE-APACHE`: upstream license texts.

These selected files retain their upstream contents. The application adaptation is
in `verifier/zkmcu-zk/src/air.rs`, generated by `scripts/adapt_zkmcu.py` and
configured by the sibling `config.rs` in that application package.

Unrelated upstream packages, benchmarks, reports, build outputs and repository
metadata are omitted. The original source remains available at the pinned URL.
